title: Slutty Hotel
summary: You’re the new owner of Slutty Hotel, and your first girl is already waiting at the door 😏🔑 With every room, the scenes get MORE EXPLICIT and the line between work and pleasure fades away 🔥 Find out right now who will become much more than just an employee. FREE TO PLAY 🥵
about:
Slutty Hotel is an 18+ idle adventure where you turn a crumbling dump on the edge of town into a seductive hotel empire. You risked everything for a fresh start and the moment the keys landed in your hand, your first girl was already waiting at the door. From there, every relationship heats up in its own way: each girl decides whether she stays just another employee or lets you get a whole lot closer.

The same dull routine, a dead-end job, and exhaustion that never goes away, sound familiar? You sold everything you owned and bought the only thing you could afford: a crumbling building on the edge of town. The plan was to turn it into a hotel and start over from scratch. But on your very first day, a girl shows up at the door, ready to take the risk with you. And it doesn’t take long to realize that the rooms themselves aren’t what really brings in the money. This is going to be anything but an ordinary hotel…

Harper, Thea, and many more… Every girl has her own story and her own reason for ending up at your hotel. One is trying to leave her past behind, another is saving up for a better life, while a third simply needs someone who finally believes in her. Hire new girls, upgrade your rooms, and become the best in the business. Get closer through private chats and unlock their personal galleries. Take each relationship from the very first message to the hottest, most explicit scenes.

At its core, the game is a familiar idle tycoon: collect resources and invest them in your rooms and girls while the business keeps running for you. The smarter your investments, the greater the returns: more money, more experience, and a better chance of getting rare items that will not simply drop on their own.
Invest your earnings in room upgrades or develop your employees by leveling them up. Every upgrade is more than just another number in the corner of the screen. It is a chance to get closer to the most explicit scenes.

In this world, girls act like real people. With every girl in Slutty Hotel, you’ll have to start from scratch, you can’t simply buy her affection. Well, maybe with a few exceptions…
Find out exactly what turns her on and remember everything she tells you. Pay close attention to her tastes, desires, and boundaries. Only then will you know when she’s ready to trust you and surrender control into your hands.

Your ambitions go far beyond making money from a single hotel. Build a team of hot girls who trust each other, and, most importantly, trust you. Turn lifeless rooms into places where the wildest fantasies come to life. Build your own personal empire of pleasure.
Open hotels in new cities, expand your influence, and watch a crumbling building on the edge of town grow into a chain that guests dream about and competitors can’t stop talking about. Become the man girls join Slutty Hotel for.

Key Features:
Hotel of pleasure: develop it into the most sinful address in town and turn it into a magnet for money
A large cast of girls, each with her own story and reason for being here
A layered relationship system, from professional conversations to intimate scenes
Room upgrades and expansion from a single building into a full hotel chain
A personal gallery for every girl, with photos and videos unlocked as you progress
A chat system with interactive conversations and dialogue choices

Completely free to start
